_comment: The demo film set's fictional company (hack/demo/README.md). Every name, address and number here is invented; phone numbers are in the fictional 555-01xx range. Addresses and hostnames stay out of frame: people sign in by their id (no SSO email on their accounts), the set's tiles show names rather than addresses, and git identities use the private-use .internal domain (gitDomain); the fixtures' own addresses (reserved .example, RFC 2606) never reach a screen. seed.sh reads this file: people become xbin users, teams become orgs. Their password is random per set: hack/demo/up.sh and the UI harness make one, keep it mode 600 beside the workspace (<workspace>.password) and print it once.

company.name: Larkspan
company.tagline: Route planning and live dispatch for regional delivery fleets
company.description: Larkspan makes route-planning and live-dispatch software for regional delivery fleets — grocery co-ops, pharmacy distributors, building suppliers and couriers running 10 to 400 vans. Thirteen people, remote-first, with a small office and a training yard in Columbus, Ohio.

agent._comment: The team's AI agent (the builtin agent template): its name in the system prompt, the captions and its git identity, and its tile. Renaming it is this block, the tile paths in data/layouts.json and the name in data/model-script.json's words.
